verdict.rationale: Otter's pricing page explicitly lists "Otter API & Webhooks" as a plan feature, and an enterprise blog post says teams can use the Public API to "trigger actions based on meeting content." That is a first-party claim of outbound webhooks, but it is only a single feature line with no detail. Zapier and the other app integrations do not count as webhook evidence. missing for 10: documentation of event types (e.g. transcript ready, meeting ended), how to register or manage webhook endpoints, payload format and auth/signing, and any independent or hands-on corroboration that webhooks work.
